name: Agui (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Agui town emblem in navy: a ring enclosing a stylised device of a vertical bar and a curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Agui, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1968.

features.role: Agui town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised device of a vertical bar and a curved stroke
